review_description: This was a new installer for Cents Solar, not one of their regulars. The job was finished at 9 pm. The system kept shutting down when there was sunlight. Installer came back a few days later to rectify faults. Again he finished at 9 pm. System still has problems of AC over voltage. I have christened the installer "The Moonlight Solar Installer". Cents Solar assure me the problems will be rectified
